limits: No native DRC, full check.sh, canonical build, CAD save, Git action, GUI retry or other-worktree write executed. Root owns integration/DRC.
All 199 existing native models were extracted; independent full maker dimensional reconstruction focused on DB125, microSD and IMU. Generic inherited models are not actual seated-part certification.

OQ-1 benchmark uses bare R25.4 bore, fixed z5 and +/-0.3 horizontal tolerance. It is not the full P2 wire bend envelope. Additional diagnostic z5.3 gives 4.940893704 mm; no impossible physical wire bend is proved and the defined benchmark is not changed.

No selected ferrule, insulation OD, bend radius, actual screwdriver/shaft/handle, lid-opening angle, finger/tool sweep, actual hardware maxima/eccentricity, coating thickness, or sled structure has been physically measured.

At selected h4 the optional inferred 100 g model gives C431 remaining gap 0.274406 mm, C421 0.348172 and L1 0.524648. h3.5 sensitivity predicts overlap at C431/C421 in that model; do not treat the stated 3.5 minimum alone as a 100 g clearance qualification. This is conditional modeling, not a demonstrated hardware failure or a reinstated frequency release threshold.
P3 five-times-100 g retention, flight shock/vibration, thermal sensor behavior, fitted modules/harness/pack stack, actual board position and on-rail screw-switch reachability remain unqualified.
